title: Street campaign panel sequence
slide_intent: Show an identity across adjacent surfaces because repetition and alternation can create recognition over a longer encounter.
strategic_value: Alternating text, imagery and the diamond mark can give Dropbox a varied but connected street presence.
demonstration: A facade carries a continuous run of green text, abstract pink imagery, a central mark, blue text and dark abstract imagery.
practical_value: Compare how neighboring panels share the work of message, expression and attribution.

content_islands.name: Five-panel run
content_islands.spec: Keep the uninterrupted left-to-right sequence and its color transitions.

content_islands.name: Facade and pavement
content_islands.spec: Retain the building and street context rather than isolating individual posters.
